conventions:
XS_SEL1 shared world: sparse cross-sectional selection book (order XS_SEL1 s1-s2; ADR-0012; contract V4). New
file; v4_world, m1_ruler, m1_common, m2h_common, m2h_dense_common and the B5 dbg_memo trainer are imported, never
modified.

  grid      V4 TRAIN (v4_world.load + world(feats=True)): 632 coins x 45288 h, panel TOP100, delisting layer.
  signal    the formula runs per calendar-year chunk (VM xs_tscs_vm_v2, the 11 terminals of m2h_common, float32
            on the GPU): the chunk's own hours plus the 2160 h before them (2021: from the grid start,
            2020-11-01), so every hour sees >= 2160 h of history (m2h/CR1 tiles: 672 h); one VM call on all
            45288 h blew past the 16 GB card (34 GiB peak on one formula). Value at hour t uses data up to t.
            Kept only where the coin is in TOP100 at t, is not BTC and has a finite beta at t.
  action    formula + hold {4,24,72,168} + state switch {all, up_lowvol, up_highvol, down_lowvol, down_highvol}
            (BTC 720 h log return > 0 / 720 h vol of hourly log returns > 0.005196, ENR1 rule) + direction
            {both, long, short}.
  book      per calendar month window (2021-01..2025-12; A = odd months, B = even, V4 contract), starting flat.
            Row r of the window uses the signal of hour r-1 (lag 1); the first row holds nothing. At hour r-1:
            no position if the state switch does not match or fewer than 20 coins have a signal; otherwise the
            K=5 highest get +, the 5 lowest get - (stable sort, ties by coin index), equal weight: both = +-1/10,
            long = +1/5, short = -1/5. Hold semantics = m1_ruler.held_path's stateful policy (minimum hold h,
            band 0.5), run as apply_stateful_action_policy_batch over the month windows (bit-equality with
            held_path checked in sel1_bench), then the v4_world delisting rule (weight 0 from the last real hour
            L on). BTC leg per row = -sum_i held_i * beta_i, beta_i = trailing 720 h OLS of hourly log returns
            on BTC (>= 360) at the signal hour of coin i's last weight change (ENR1b: beta of the trigger hour).
  settle    m1_ruler.settle_multi on the columns [held coins..., BTC] (columns never held contribute nothing, so
            this equals the full book), fwd = m1_ruler.prepare_shard(winsor_pct=0) + v4_world.install_layer
            (no winsor), flat6 / cost0, funding, Rule 0. Held and fwd column counts asserted equal.
  reward    A half: sum over A months of cost0 log NAV / A days, bp/day (funding paid, no trading cost).
  null      the formula's signal shifted per coin circularly by a fixed offset (uniform in [720, T-720], seed
            NULL_SEED) before the TOP100 / beta mask; returns untouched.
  plant     pc: fwd[i,t] += alpha * zp[i,t-1], zp = D.plant_signal (TOP100 rank z of
            DELTA(TS_MEAN(log_quote_volume,168),168)); alpha calibrated in sel1_calib.py (SEL1_ALPHA.json).
            pcnull: the NULL world (same offsets) plus a plant; zp = the plant formula's NULL-shifted signal
            (plant_signal_shifted), so the plant is what a formula sees in that world; alpha explicit.
trainer:
XS_SEL1 trainer x2 = sel1_trainer_x.py (sha16 c5d132520d7a0fc1, NOT modified; ARMS v1 runs that file) plus the
ARMS v2 switches (supplement 10-16 noon, sel1_search2), all default off; --combo-sweep only:
  --risk-seek E  DSO risk-seeking PG: one row per body (its first valid row, plus --pq rows), select_risk_elite at
                 quantile 1 - E, advantage r - q on the elite only (no family z). ARMS v2: 0.05.
  --pq N         the hall's top N (by score, bodies not in this batch) teacher-forced through the sampler (current
                 policy, same tables + grammar mask) and mixed into the update with their hall score (rounded to
                 4 dp as the hall stores it). With --risk-seek (PG) or --gfn2 (off-policy replay). ARMS v2: 64.
  --ent-gamma G  entropy step decay of the PG step: 0.7 (default) = DSO's hierarchical entropy regularizer, the
                 value dense_update hard-codes; 1.0 = flat. ARMS v2 PG-risk: 1.0.
  --gfn2 B       trajectory balance with one log Z per basin (sel1_search2.LogZB), BETA = B x sel1_gfn.BETA_MULT,
                 invalid R = sel1_gfn.INVALID_R; with --explore and --pq.
  --explore E    sampling draws from (1 - E) pi + E uniform over legal tokens; losses use log pi. ARMS v2 GFN: 0.05.
With every switch off the update path is sel1_trainer_x's line for line (self-check: fork of V2 PC ckpt 0015).

sel1_trainer_x header follows.

XS_SEL1 trainer x = sel1_trainer.py (sha16 89b4e4ac2abddc00, NOT modified; the V2 chain runs that file) plus
switches that default off, so a run without them is sel1_trainer's (supplement 10-15 afternoon / evening):
  --dedup    behaviour identity = sel1_dedup.behaviour_hash of the A-half selections (the long / short coin sets of
             every trading A hour). A body whose identity was seen before (an earlier update, or an earlier row of
             this update) is invalid DUP_* (advantage -1), not scored; the same body again is DUP_BODY without a VM
             call. The family z uses sel1_dedup.zfam (std < 1e-12 -> the family's advantages are 0). --combo-sweep only.
  --pool N   AlphaGen pool reward (evening item 5 + correction), sel1_pool composites. Candidate f, rho = max corr of
             its A-half monthly cost0 (own t_dd book) with the members', j = that member:
               rho <= 0.7  gain = t_dd(pool + f) - t_dd(pool);  rho > 0.7  gain = t_dd(pool - j + f) - t_dd(pool);
               f selects exactly what a member selects (behaviour hash) -> invalid POOL_SAME.
             t_dd(empty pool) = 0. Advantage = gain / std(valid gains) clipped +-3 (std < 1e-12 -> 0), invalid -1,
             no mean subtracted. After the update the best gain > 0 is executed (add / replace; a full pool drops the
             one of 21 whose removal leaves the highest t_dd, newcomer included). Hall / single gate unchanged.
             POOL_LOG.jsonl per update, POOL.json at the end. Needs --combo-sweep --gpu-select --gpu-workers 0.
  --gfn B    trajectory balance (sel1_gfn): loss (log Z + sum log pi - B t_dd)^2, invalid t_dd = -3; replaces the
             policy-gradient step. --frozen: no update at all (random baseline, policy stays at u0).
  --plant2 F second plant (sel1_world2, SEL1_ARMS world): F = json with body / alpha; --mode pcnull only.
  --fork     resume a checkpoint with --pool / --dedup / --gfn / --frozen / --plant2 changed (self-checks, ARMS).
  --receipt-on-stop  a --max-hours stop also writes HOF.json and the receipt (stopped=true).

sel1_trainer header follows.

XS_SEL1 trainer: sparse cross-sectional selection book (order XS_SEL1 s1-s4; ADR-0012; contract V4). New file.
The grammar-masked sampler, the basin view, the policy-gradient step and the checkpoint plumbing are
m2h_b5_trainer_dbg_memo's functions, imported unchanged; the world and the book are sel1_common's.

  action   body (B5 grammar, basin token T1/T2/T3 with its terminals, quota 43/43/42 of 128) + three appended
           tokens with autograd live: hold {4,24,72,168}, state switch (5), direction {both,long,short}.
  reward   A half (V4 odd months, 30 windows): --reward mean (default, the original) = cost0 beta-hedged log NAV
           of the book, bp/day; t = monthly t of it; t_dd = t, 0 above the A-half max drawdown --dd-max
           (S.reward). Logs keep reward_bpd = cost0 bp/day and add score when --reward is not mean.
           Within-family z +-3 over valid candidates, invalid -1; dense update (dbg_memo, every candidate),
           entropy coefficient ent_coef.
  floor    entropy floor: floor = ent_floor_frac x the batch mean entropy of update 0; while an update's mean
           entropy is under the floor the coefficient is multiplied by 1.5 (cap 0.3), otherwise it decays by
           1/1.1 back towards ent_coef. State kept in the checkpoint.
  hall     every valid candidate (body, hold, state, direction) with its A reward (deterministic: all 30 A
           windows every time), top 5000 kept; HOF.json = top 500 at the end. B is never computed here.
  speed    --workers 0 --gpu-workers 0 --memo update: everything in this process, each body / candidate scored
           once per update (the baseline). --memo global: a candidate's reward and a body's selections are
           deterministic, so they are cached across updates. --workers N: book scores in N CPU processes;
           --gpu-workers G: the VM in G GPU processes. None of these changes a result: the zero-diff check
           resumes the baseline's checkpoint with the fast settings and compares the logs line by line.
  log      BATCH_LOG.jsonl per update, FORMULAS.jsonl per candidate; every 64 updates: distinct-formula share
           and the most frequent formula per family.

    python -I sel1_trainer.py OUT --mode real|null|pc|pcnull --updates N [--k K] [--alpha A]
                              [--reward mean|t|t_dd --dd-max D] [--resume auto]
